note: This file is the authoritative, machine-readable trial count for the lead-lag family's multiple-testing correction denominator. The denominator is COMPUTED as len(trials), never hand-typed into a markdown document. Any markdown document (preregistration, feasibility doc, findings) that states a trial count must derive it from this file, not restate it independently -- see lead_lag/ledger.py:denominator(). Appending a new trial here requires a git commit of this file, which is the enforcement mechanism against the POC-family failure mode (PROJECT_CONTEXT.md Section 3: Bonferroni denominator stayed pinned at 2 across three preregistrations while the real trial count reached 5, because the count lived only in prose).
